evidence.title: Tabler Icons: 6200+ free vector icons for web design

name: Tabler Icons
summary: 6,200+ free MIT-licensed SVG icons on a 24×24 grid, with React, Vue, SolidJS and Figma packages.
description: A complete open-source icon set of 6,238 icons drawn on a 24×24 grid with a 2px stroke, browsable by search and category with live size, stroke and color controls. Icons ship as source SVG, HTML images, SVG sprites, webfont and PNG/PDF downloads, with components for React, SolidJS and Vue and a Figma plugin. Free under MIT; optional $9 and $69 bundles add compiled formats and premium assets.
contains: 24×24 grid with 2px stroke; size, stroke and color customisable
SVG source, HTML images, SVG sprites, webfont, PNG/PDF
React, SolidJS and Vue components plus a Figma plugin
free MIT source with optional $9 and $69 bundles
